recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5981 unless the work group later resolves FHIR-56399 or a similar issue to change the datatype or versioning model for terminology operation context parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-5981 was Published/Persuasive for a compatible substantive DSTU1 Vocabulary change requesting a context parameter in ValueSet terminology operations. The accepted resolution defined context as a uri that can be supplied in place of valueSet, normally using a StructureDefinition URL plus a fragment naming or pathing into the structure definition, while leaving other forms undefined.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision 5719. The converted git history contains ca6ed70bdea0f16cd6171d9cf200fbb46787a087 with git-svn-id build@5719 and subject '#5981 - add $expand.context'; that patch updated the old ValueSet spreadsheet to allow identifier/context/valueset for expansion and added both expand.context and validate-code.context URI parameters with the requested StructureDefinition#path guidance. Later refactors moved those operation definitions into source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml and source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ValueSet as an active resource owned by vocab, and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-expand and OperationDefinition/ValueSet-validate-code. Current source says one of url, context, or valueSet must be provided when those operations are not called at instance level, and both operation definitions carry the requested context parameter documentation. Later Published issue FHIR-13326 relies on this context behavior for validate-code; unresolved Triaged issue FHIR-56399 may revisit uri/canonical details in the future but is not a final change. Zulip discussion in #terminology confirms implementer understanding of the context syntax and did not reveal a conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already implements the FHIR-5981 request for both active ValueSet operations, including the StructureDefinition#[name or path] URI form and context as an alternative to direct value set selection.

related_jiras.note: Later Published validate-code clarification assumes the context parameter can identify the binding used for code validation.
Unresolved/Triaged R6 discussion of uri-typed terminology operation parameters, including ValueSet $validate-code context, but not a final decision affecting this reconciliation.
